title: Two-grid Penalty Approximation Scheme for Doubly Reflected BSDEs
summary: We study penalization coupled with time discretization for decoupled Markovian doubly reflected BSDEs with obstacles \(p_b(t,X_t)\le Y_t\le p_w(t,X_t)\). The DRBSDE is approximated by a penalized BSDE with parameter \(λ\) and discretized by an implicit Euler scheme with step \(Δt\). A key difficulty is that the forward approximation used to evaluate the obstacles generates an error term that is amplified by \(λ\).
